voltage-lime.$description: Voltage Lime — Primary action fill, nav pill, active state, hero gradient endpoint — the single chromatic ignition point against an otherwise monochrome system

cyan-spark.$description: Cyan Spark — Hero gradient start point, secondary glow tone — pairs with Voltage Lime to create the aurora-like radial background

mid-abyss.$description: Mid Abyss — Footer surface, dark section backgrounds — a near-black with a subtle teal undertone that keeps the dark mode on-brand

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, input borders — the slightly cool near-black used for the majority of foreground content

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on lime fills, input interiors — the dominant surface tone (1590+ appearances)

true-black.$description: True Black — Nav borders, strong text emphasis, icon fills — used sparingly where maximum contrast is needed

ash.$description: Ash — Body helper text, muted body borders — the secondary text level for de-emphasized copy

noigrotesk.$description: Primary UI and body typeface — handles all navigation, buttons, inputs, cards, and headings up to 40px. Custom grotesque with active stylistic sets ss03, ss06, and ss12 that subtly shape letterforms across the entire system

sansplomb.$description: Display-only typeface for hero and section-defining headlines. Used at 201px with ultra-tight 0.80 line-height and -0.020em tracking — the sheer scale makes the headline feel architectural, not typographic

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
